deployment_model: single native Go binary under systemd on Raspberry Pi (ARM64) — no container, no new service; AI provider is an external HTTPS endpoint

requirement_compliance.title: Generate AI explanation of system state / insight
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-016h/016e/016f pass (3/3): grounded cause+remediation, prompt caps, insufficient→422 with no audit-log action

requirement_compliance.title: AI provider API key stored encrypted at rest
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-017h/017e/017f pass: ciphertext at rest + decrypt round-trip + key never returned by GET nor present in logs

requirement_compliance.title: AI provider configuration in Settings panel
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-018h/018e/018f pass (persist, section renders with 44px targets, empty-endpoint blocked); 375px pixel/viewport fidelity is manual (no browser e2e runner) — declared debt

requirement_compliance.title: Graceful degradation when AI is not configured
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-019h/019e/019f pass: settings render clean, Enabled()=false, explain→409 not 500, /health 200

requirement_compliance.title: Provider-agnostic, swappable AI configuration
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-020h/020e/020f pass: model swap takes effect with no restart, request built for any base URL, unreachable endpoint→typed 502, no panic

requirement_compliance.title: Bounded, fail-closed AI request handling
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-021h/021e/021f pass: timeout aborts ~1s, 401/malformed→502 no crash, /health stays 200

requirement_compliance.title: AI explanation surface with loading/success/error/empty states
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-022h/022e/022f pass at the server-contract layer (200/422/502 drive the panel states); browser-level loading <=200ms and 375px verified manually — declared debt

requirement_compliance.title: No secrets in the prompt or AI logs (redaction)
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-023h/023e/023f pass: known-secret + secret-shaped redaction; 3 DB secrets absent from outbound prompt and logs

requirement_compliance.title: Explanation cites the evidence it used
requirement_compliance.evidence: Implemented (cited_signals + 'unverified' label in parseExplanation and ai-explain.js) and exercised within TC-AI-016h/022h, but has no dedicated passing TC (SHOULD, no user story)

requirement_compliance.title: Test-connection action in AI settings
requirement_compliance.evidence: POST /api/ai/test implemented and wired to the Settings button; no dedicated passing TC (NICE); returns JSON, status-chip polish is declared debt

requirement_compliance.title: Push AI explanation to Telegram on alert fire (additive, best-effort)
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-026h/026e/026f pass: alert+AI follow-up, push-off sends only alert, AI failure keeps exactly one rule-based alert (no drop/duplicate)

requirement_compliance.title: AI credentials handled to the existing secret standard
requirement_compliance.evidence: Reuses AES-GCM secrets.go; https-by-default with explicit insecure override; covered by FR-017/FR-023 tests

requirement_compliance.title: Bounded explanation latency, non-blocking
requirement_compliance.evidence: context.WithTimeout(timeout_ms, default 10s); TC-AI-021h/021e verify bound and responsiveness

requirement_compliance.title: AI subsystem fails closed and isolated
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-AI-019f/021f: provider faults never crash the process; /health stays 200; alert path isolated (TC-AI-026f)

requirement_compliance.title: Observability: AI request outcome logging
requirement_compliance.evidence: log.Printf outcome/skip lines in dispatcher follow-up and handlers; no dedicated metric TC; no secret in logs verified by TC-AI-017f/023f

requirement_compliance.title: CI/CD exercises internal/ai
requirement_compliance.evidence: Tests live in root internal/... packages; ci.yml (vet, go test -race, arm64 build) and security-gate.yml (go test, govulncheck) run them on every push/PR; vet + arm64 quality gates pass in verify-run
